messages.subject: Error found in gl2bayescan
parts:
Hi,

I thought I'd let you know about some mistakes in gl2bayescan. The gl2bayescan function outputs the same population x amount of time (x referring to the number of populations in the dataset) instead of all the populations one after the other.

I edited the code and it works. Please find the edited code at: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1cd_wKQQg5EIfh-gKqqJrRwatUVR2tkcj/view?usp=sharing (I edited line 89 in the file).

Cheers,
Kamolphat (A)
